description: The bar chart illustrates perplexity values for two methods, labeled “Ours” and “Uniform”, across varying quantization bit levels. The horizontal axis represents quantization bits, with labels 3, 4, 8, and 16, and is a linear scale. The vertical axis represents perplexity, labeled as “Perplexity”, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 30 in charts (a) and (c), and 0 to 400 in chart (b), with tick labels at intervals of 5 in (a) and (c), and 50 in (b). Each chart contains paired bars for each quantization bit level; a blue bar represents “Ours” and an orange bar represents “Uniform”. In chart (a), the “Ours” bars range in height from approximately 22 at 16 bits to 44 at 3 bits, while the “Uniform” bars range from approximately 13 at 16 bits to 23 at 3 bits. In chart (b), the “Ours” bars range in height from approximately 170 at 16 bits to 320 at 3 bits, while the “Uniform” bars range from approximately 100 at 16 bits to 380 at 3 bits. In chart (c), the “Ours” bars range in height from approximately 15 at 16 bits to 28 at 3 bits, while the “Uniform” bars range from approximately 8 at 16 bits to 18 at 3 bits. The bars within each chart are arranged in ascending order based on the quantization bit level. No bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotation.
